description:
Cast Flash putting Protean Hulk into play.
Protean hulk dies with trigger, grabbing putrid imp and gitrog monster.
Discard dakmor salvage to putrid imp, trigger gitrog to draw, replace draw for dredge 2 on dakmor salvage.
Repeat step 3 until either no cards are left in library or you are comfortable with what is left.
By this point a Narcomoeba has been milled (hopefully) and is now on your field.Sacrificegitrog, Narcomoeba, and putrid imp to flashback dread return in grave target thassa's oracle and win.
